```{r settings}
# ── User settings ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
home_path         <- "/path/to/project/"   # trailing slash required
bias_peaks_path   <- "data/bias_peaks.xlsx" # path to input Excel file, relative to home_path
peaks_out_path    <- "data/consensus_peaks.csv" # output CSV path, relative to home_path
min_peak_consensus <- 3                    # minimum number of algorithms that must agree on a peak
path_to_bed_output <- "../out/beds/"            # directory to save bed files, relative to this script
# ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
```

```{r load, echo=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)

full_path <- paste0(home_path, bias_peaks_path)
data <- read_excel(full_path)
```

```{r}
#get rid of irellevent cols
df <- data |>
  select(- matches("\\..+")) |> #get rid of data cols
  select(c("seqnames", "start", "end"), matches("_MuMerge_")) |>
  rename( chr = seqnames)  |>
  tibble::rowid_to_column( "ID")
```
```{r}
#now convert to long format
#and add some data cols from the names
pattern <- "\\d+_Male_([^_]+).+_MuMerge_(.+$)"
# example name
# 1_Male_2wk_ATAC_vs_Female_2wk_ATAC_MuMerge_CSAW


long_df <- pivot_longer(df,  matches("_MuMerge_")) |>
  extract(
    col = name,
    into = c("age", "method"),
    regex = pattern,
    remove = FALSE
)
```


```{r}

# returns list of peaks that match min requirements
# also removes X and Y chromosomes
build_peak_counts <- function(long_df, min_peak_consensus) {
  final <- long_df %>%
    rename( bias = value) %>%
    group_by(ID,chr, start, end, age, bias) %>%
    summarise(
      n = n()
    ) %>%
    filter(
      chr != 'chrY',
      chr != 'chrX',
      bias == 'UP_STRONG' | bias == 'DOWN_STRONG',
      n >= min_peak_consensus
    ) %>%
    mutate(bias = str_replace_all(bias, "UP", "MALE")) |> 
    mutate(bias = str_replace_all(bias, "DOWN", "FEMALE")) 
  return(final)
}
final <- build_peak_counts(long_df, min_peak_consensus)

write_csv(final, paste0(home_path, peaks_out_path))
```
### Save bed files for downstream analysis
```{r}
bed_df <- final |>
  mutate(
    ID = paste0(ID,"ID"),
    group_id = paste0(age, "_", bias))

for(group in unique(bed_df$group_id)) {
  bed_data <- bed_df |>
    filter(group_id == group) |>
    select(chr, start, end, ID)
  filename <- paste0(path_to_bed_output, group,".bed")
  write_delim(bed_data, filename, delim = "\t", col_names = FALSE, row_names = FALSE)
}
```

## statistics
### For Consensus Peaks

```{r}
make_bar_plot <- function(df, title) {
  # plot number of peaks in each condition
  counts_table <- df %>%
    mutate(age = str_replace(age, "4wk2days", "4wk2d")) %>%
    group_by(bias, age) %>%
    summarise(count = n())
  counts_table$age <- factor(counts_table$age, levels = c("2wk","3wk","4wk","4wk2d","5wk","6wk","8wk"))
  
  p <- ggplot(counts_table, aes(age, count, fill = bias)) +
    geom_bar(position = "dodge", stat = "identity") + 
    scale_x_discrete( drop = FALSE) +
    ggtitle(title)
  
  return(p)
}


```

```{r}
for (min_c in 1:6) {
  df <- build_peak_counts(long_df, min_c)
  
  #get the total number of unique peaks
  num_unique <- df %>%
    select(chr, start, end) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    nrow()
  
  print( paste("Number of distinct peaks for min consensus", min_c, ":", num_unique))
  
  p <- make_bar_plot(df, paste("Number of Biased peaks called by", min_c, "or more algorithms"))
  print(p)
  
  fig_path <- paste0("Figs/Data_Formatting/consensus_", min_c, ".png")
  ggsave(p, file = fig_path, height = 6, width = 10)

}

```
### For Individual Peak Calling Methods
```{r}
# same as last method, but only selects peaks from a single method
build_peak_counts_single_method <- function(long_df, chosen_method) {
  final <- long_df %>%
    rename( bias = value) %>%
    filter(
      chr != 'chrY',
      chr != 'chrX',
      bias == 'UP_STRONG' | bias == 'DOWN_STRONG',
      chosen_method == method
    ) %>%
    mutate(bias = str_replace_all(bias, "UP", "MALE")) |> 
    mutate(bias = str_replace_all(bias, "DOWN", "FEMALE")) 
  return(final)
}
```

```{r}
for (chosen_method in unique(long_df$method)) {
  df <- build_peak_counts_single_method(long_df, chosen_method)
  
  #get the total number of unique peaks
  num_unique <- df %>%
    select(chr, start, end) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    nrow()
  
  print( paste("Number of distinct peaks for ", chosen_method, ":", num_unique))
  
  p <- make_bar_plot(df, paste("Number of Biased peaks called by", chosen_method))
  print(p)
  
  fig_path <- paste0("Figs/Data_Formatting/", chosen_method, ".png")
  ggsave(p, file = fig_path, height = 6, width = 10)
  

}

```

### Combined Figure: Consensus 1, 3, 5 + CSAW, DESEQ2, DIFFREPS200


```{r}
library(patchwork)
library(cowplot)

# Build all six plots
consensus_levels <- c(1, 3, 5)
consensus_plots <- lapply(consensus_levels, function(min_c) {
  df <- build_peak_counts(long_df, min_c)
  make_bar_plot(df, paste("Consensus ≥", min_c))
})

target_methods <- c("CSAW", "DESEQ2", "DIFFREPS_200")
method_plots <- lapply(target_methods, function(m) {
  df <- build_peak_counts_single_method(long_df, m)
  make_bar_plot(df, m)
})
```
```{r}
# Extract legend as horizontal
shared_legend <- get_legend(consensus_plots[[1]] + guides(fill = guide_legend(nrow = 1)) ) 
  

# Strip legends from all panels
all_plots_no_legend <- lapply(c(consensus_plots, method_plots), 
                               function(p) p + theme(legend.position = "none"))

# Arrange the 6 panels in a 2x3 grid
grid <- plot_grid(plotlist = all_plots_no_legend, nrow = 2)

# Stack grid on top, legend on bottom
combined_fig <- plot_grid(grid, shared_legend, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(1, 0.1)) 

combined_fig <- combined_fig + plot_annotation(title = "Biased Peak Counts: Consensus Thresholds and Individual Methods")

print(combined_fig)
ggsave(combined_fig, file = "Figs/Data_Formatting/combined_consensus_methods.png",
       height = 7, width = 11)
```
